title_ru: Дети Атома — атом как вселенная / раскол как рождение миров
title_en: Children of Atom — Atom as Universe / Fission as World-Birth
core_statement_ru: В Fallout 3 Дети Атома верят, что каждый атом содержит целую вселенную, а разделение атомной массы разделяет вселенную и может порождать новые миры. Мы сохраняем это как каноническую внутриигровую космологию фракции, но не выдаём её за установленный физический факт нашего мира.
user_hypothesis_ru: Если человеческое ядерное деление в один исторический момент раскололо огромное количество атомных систем, возможно, в вымышленной космологии Fallout этот акт соответствует массовому branching event, а получившиеся миры со временем разворачиваются в самостоятельные вселенные и космосы.

claims: Each single atomic mass in all of creation contains an entire universe.
When that atomic mass is split, a single universe divides and becomes two.
Occasionally a divine event creates trillions upon trillions of new universes.
Cromwell identifies the last such event with the Great War approximately 200 years earlier.

layer_1_game_canon.statement: The Children of Atom explicitly believe atomic division produces universe division.

layer_2_structural_science_rhyme.statement: Modern quantum theory admits interpretations in which decoherence corresponds to branching structure, making the Fallout metaphor superficially resonant with many-worlds language.
layer_2_structural_science_rhyme.source: Phys. Rev. D 85, 045007; APS Quantum Milestones

layer_3_real_physics.statement: Nuclear fission does not currently establish that a new spacetime universe is physically created. Standard nuclear physics treats fission as a change in nuclear configuration with conservation laws, not universe creation.

layer_4_user_hypothesis.statement: A sufficiently large number of microscopic quantum branching events could be interpreted, under a many-worlds ontology, as a vastly branching global quantum state; this is not the same as producing separate classical universes from each nuclear fission event.

important_correction.fallout_claim: One atom split -> one universe becomes two, according to Cromwell.
important_correction.physics_claim: One fission event -> one new universe.
important_correction.relation: The former is an in-universe theological cosmology; the latter is not established by modern physics.

atomic_registry_principle.name: CHILDREN_OF_ATOM
atomic_registry_principle.formula_ru: АТОМ → ВНУТРЕННЯЯ ВСЕЛЕННАЯ → РАСКОЛ → РАЗДВОЕНИЕ МИРА → МНОЖЕСТВО МИРОВ
atomic_registry_principle.formula_en: ATOM → INTERNAL UNIVERSE → SPLIT → WORLD DIVISION → MANY WORLDS
atomic_registry_principle.meaning: The atomic registry records the Fallout cosmology as a model of transformation: destruction is reinterpreted by the Children of Atom as creation, and division becomes multiplication of possible worlds.

relationship_to_hawkar_atomic_registry.children_of_atom_extension: The registry does not erase indivisibility; it records the paradox that what is indivisible in one ontology may be generative when divided in another.
relationship_to_hawkar_atomic_registry.ethical_boundary: Do not romanticize real nuclear destruction or imply that real-world suffering is justified by speculative cosmology.

testable_next_steps: Audit all Fallout 3 Children of Atom dialogue for consistent atom/universe/division vocabulary.
Search Fallout 3 terminals, holotapes and DLC for independent references to universe creation by atom splitting.
Compare the Children of Atom cosmology with Mothership Zeta crystal/examination motifs without assuming identity.
Search Fallout 2 and later Fallout titles for whether the atomic-universe doctrine changes, expands or remains stable.
Construct a controlled comparison between Fallout cosmology and documented quantum branching interpretations, keeping metaphor and physics separate.
notes: This entry intentionally preserves both the power of the Fallout 3 idea and the boundary between fictional cosmology, quantum interpretation, and established physical fact.
